target_segments: Anticoagulant therapy is prohibited; low-dose prophylactic heparin is permitted if the participant remains within therapeutic monitoring range.

text_span: low-dose prophylactic heparin is permitted if the participant remains within therapeutic monitoring range
sub_criteria.rationale: H4 conditional allowance: prophylactic heparin is an anticoagulant therapy that the main prohibition would otherwise exclude; this phrase permits it when the monitoring condition is met.

output.notes: The main anticoagulant-therapy prohibition is one proposition; the monitoring condition is part of the conditional allowance.
